summary: Theme zero's dark scheme becomes WARM INK (ADR 0008, 0016 and 0017 amended). The mid-grey neutral-20 page inverted elevation — #423E3A sat lighter than the #2F2C29 cards on it — and primary ink measured 9.59:1 on it. The page is now #171411 (L* 6.5) from a new DARK ramp in palette.ts, keyed by CIE L* and carrying ~0.0075 OKLCH chroma at hue 67, half again NEUTRAL's, because near black a lighter tint disappears and the first near-black candidate read as generic black. Every ground goes up from the page: rail #1C1916, surface #1E1B18, elevated #2A2724; the page field is a shallow well, #120F0C at 1.04:1 under the page with the hairline identifying it. Primary ink 17.18:1 on the page, 16.05:1 on a surface; muted 6.56:1; border-control 4.59:1; intent inks 6.5–9.1:1 on grounds composited over the surface. With it: link and focus are blue-80, danger ink red-70, categorical solids step 70, the accent wash 0.10 / 0.16, and --ui-bg-emphasis inverts to paper (#F6F3F0, ink #1D1B19, 15.53:1) because neutral-0 is now the surface itself and the Tooltip chip vanished. Departures from the approved Paper boards: hover / active / selected are opaque steps rather than the drawn 5% wash, so hover still steps past elevated (the chrome control's ramp); and --ui-bg-sunken is a FILL in dark (#383531, above the surface) rather than the drawn recess, because near black a recess measured 1.03:1 on the page and Skeleton, the Progress track, the neutral Banner and the placeholders disappeared — so avatars and neutral badges now read as chips, not wells. It sits one step above border-subtle so DotPattern's dots still read on it (1.12:1; a new resolve.test.ts assertion holds the pair at 1.1 in both schemes). The Slider's open track gap closes with it (1.41:1 on a surface). --ui-border-default is one step further out than drawn (#45423E) so DotPattern's strong opt-in reads stronger than its default on the sunken fill (1.22 vs 1.12:1). Light is unchanged to the byte (resolved theme diffed before and after); 65 dark roles moved. Paper: https://app.paper.design/file/01KZ39A2BC286MT85M658NRR4R/p-10-0 (Round 4 --- B4 Draft, tuned; Round 4 --- Test layout, Guidelines). Every dark visual baseline moves; not regenerated with this change.

migration.manual: Re-emit your token CSS (or re-install theme-zero-css). Any local :root override of a dark --ui-bg-* or --ui-border-* value was written against the mid-grey ramp and should be removed rather than carried over: several now invert the order they were written to fix. A consumer that read --ui-bg-emphasis as 'always near-black' must not: in dark it is paper. Nothing in the registry other than Tooltip paints it.
